items.question: When is the best time to sell property in Dubai?
items.answer: Dubai's real estate market is active year-round, however peak periods are October-May when more buyers and investors arrive in the emirate. We recommend starting sale preparation in advance to enter the market at the optimal time.

items.question: Can I sell property with a tenant?
items.answer: Yes, you can. Properties with current tenants are often attractive to investors as they immediately receive income. We'll help properly arrange such a transaction considering all tenant rights and buyer requirements.

items.question: How long does the sale take?
items.answer: On average, from listing the property to completing the transaction takes 2-4 months. This depends on property type, price, location and market conditions. Exclusive properties can sell faster with our buyer database.

items.question: Are there taxes when selling?
items.answer: There is no capital gains tax in UAE when selling property. Main costs are agency commission (usually 2% of value) and DLD government fee (4% of transaction value), which is split between buyer and seller.

items.question: How to determine a fair price?
items.answer: We conduct comprehensive analysis: study recent sales of similar properties, current market offers, consider property condition, location, views and infrastructure. Based on this data, we propose optimal price that will attract buyers and ensure profitable sale.
